title: (RHBA-2020:0290) glusterfs client bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated Red Hat Gluster Storage client packages are now available on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.
portal_synopsis: glusterfs client bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for x86_64|8|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Storage is software-only, scale-out storage that provides flexible and affordable unstructured data storage for an enterprise. GlusterFS, a key building block of Red Hat Storage, is based on a stackable user-space design and can deliver exceptional performance for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates various storage servers over network interconnects into one large, parallel network file system. 

* With Red Hat Gluster Storage 3.5 Batch Update 1, native client packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 have been provisioned in the Red Hat Common channel. This enables the availability of Red Hat Gluster Storage volumes on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 machines. (BZ#1775539) 

Users of Red Hat Gluster Storage are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
portal_product_names: Red Hat Enterprise Linux for x86_64
